newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dlr could reach 1.60 marks - Commerzbank forex head.
newsitem.headline: Dlr could reach 1.60 marks - Commerzbank forex head.

text.p: The head of Commerzbank AG's currency dealing business, Alfred Schorno, said on Wednesday that a dollar appreciation to 1.60 marks was realistic in the short term.
The dollar could even reach 1.65 marks, Schorno said in an interview on Germany's ZDF television channel. In the long term, the U.S. currency will fall back to 1.55-1.60 marks, he said.
Schorno said one of the reasons for the dollar's rise in recent days was scepticism in currency markets about the launch of European monetary union.
The dollar was at 1.5575/85 marks at 0830 GMT in Europe.
